get.summary:
Downloads a consistent copy of the database: a SQLite file with every
table, taken of one moment while the gateway goes on. It holds
everything the database holds (users with their password hashes,
sessions, logs, provider credentials as they are stored) except the
master key, which is not in it: the credentials are unreadable without
that key, and so the copy is of little use without it. Admin only; the
download is audited.

200.description: The database as a SQLite file.

401.description: No valid session or access token.

403.description: The caller is not allowed to do this.

get.summary:
The budgets the caller may see: all of them, with what each has spent in
its current period, for an admin. Anyone else sees the gateway's and
those of their teams without the spend (with it for a team they lead),
and those of themselves and their own keys with the spend.

200.description: The budgets that apply to the caller.

401.description: No valid session or access token.

put.summary:
Sets the budget of a team, a user, a key or the gateway for a period:
the amount and what happens when it is spent. A second call for the same
subject and period changes that budget. Admin only. The change reaches
`/v1` at once.

parameters.name: x-csrf-token
parameters.description: The CSRF token of the session. Required with a session cookie; not needed with an access token.

200.description: The budget after the change.

get.summary:
The configuration of the gateway as one JSON file: providers (without
their credentials), models with their grants, teams, routes, limits and
budgets (those of keys left out) and settings. It holds no key, token,
password, session, log or audit row.

200.description: The configuration file, as a download.

401.description: No valid session or access token.

403.description: The caller is not allowed to do this.

post.summary:
Checks a configuration file and, with `dry_run=false`, writes it. Without
`dry_run` it is a dry run. Missing things are created and existing ones,
by name, are updated; nothing is deleted. A file with any error writes
nothing: the answer is 422 with the report. A new provider has no
credential until an admin sets one.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: `true` (the default) only reports; `false` writes.

parameters.name: x-csrf-token
parameters.description: The CSRF token of the session. Required with a session cookie; not needed with an access token.

200.description: What was written, or with a dry run what would be.

422.description: The file has errors, which the report lists. Nothing was written.

get.summary:
Newest first. `before` is the id of the last row of the page before.
Filters only narrow what the caller may see.
get.description:
What a caller sees depends on who they are. An admin sees every row. A
team lead sees the rows of the teams they lead, the rows of the users who
are members of those teams, and their own. Anyone else sees their own
rows. A lead's scope uses the CURRENT membership: a row linked to a team
only by its user leaves the lead's view when that user leaves the team.
Rows of keys without an owner are visible to admins only.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many rows to return, 1 to 200. 50 when left out.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The id of the last row of the page before.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only calls at or after this time: RFC 3339, or a date `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC, from its start).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only calls at or before this time: RFC 3339, or a date `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC, to its end).

parameters.name: key_id
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Only calls of this user.

parameters.name: team_id
parameters.description: Only calls of this team.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Only calls answered by, or asking for, this model name.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only calls answered with this HTTP status, 100 to 599.

parameters.name: errors
parameters.description: `true`: only calls answered with a status of 400 or more. Combines with the other filters.

200.description: The calls the caller may see, newest first.

400.description: The request is not of the expected form.

401.description: No valid session or access token.

422.description: Some parameters are not valid; `fields` names each of them.

get.summary: Sums of the calls in a range of days, by day, model, key, user or team.
get.description:
What a caller sees depends on who they are, as in the log list. An admin
sees every call. A team lead sees the calls of the teams they lead, the
calls of the users who are members of those teams, and their own. Anyone
else sees their own calls, so grouping by user or team shows only
themselves and the teams on their own calls. A lead's scope uses the
CURRENT membership: a call linked to a team only by its user leaves the
lead's totals when that user leaves the team. Calls of keys without an
owner count for admins only. Days are UTC. The range is at most 366 days;
it defaults to the last 30 days.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day, `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC). 29 days before `to` when left out.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day, `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC), counted whole. Today when left out.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: `day` (the default), `model`, `key`, `user` or `team`.

200.description: The sums, one row per group, and their total.

For `validation_failed` only: a message for each field that is not
valid.

message.description: Text for a person. It may change.

name.description: The team's name or the user's email; `null` for the gateway.

action.description:
`block` refuses calls once the amount is spent; `alert` allows them
and writes one audit entry per period.

amount_micros.description: The amount, in millionths of a dollar.

label.description:
How a message names it: `gateway`, `team 'Platform'`,
`user 'lena@example.com'` or `key 'ci'`.

period_start.description: The UTC date the current period began on, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

scope_id.description: The id of the team, user or key; `null` for the gateway.

spent_micros.description:
What the gateway counted as spent in the current period, in
millionths of a dollar. `null` when the caller may not see it: a
member sees the spend of their own user and keys and of no one else's,
nor of the gateway or of a team they do not lead.

ConfigFile.description: The configuration file. `format` and `version` come first.

allowed.description:

catalog, or the name of a route. Left out, the key has no allowlist.

name.description: The provider's id for the model, 1 to 200 characters, no whitespace.

secret.description:

empty.

everyone.description:
Every user may call the model. It cannot be combined with teams or
users.

errors.description: With any error nothing is written.

unchanged.description: How many things of the file were there already, as they are.

invite_link.description:

this answer, and cannot be read again.

at.description: Where, as `models[0].grants.teams[1]`; `file` for the file as a whole.

changes.description: For an update: the fields that change. Empty for a creation.

allowed.description: The models and routes the key may call; `null` is no limit.

status.description:
`revoked`, `expired`, `suspended` or `active`, the first that
applies. `suspended`: the owner of the key is not active, so the key
does not work until they are. Only an `active` key works.

name.description: The team's name or the user's email; `null` for the gateway.

The limits of one team, user, key or of the gateway. A limit that is

outcome.description: `ok`, `retryable`, `fatal`, `circuit_open`, `skipped` or `cached` (answered from the response cache, no provider called).

status.description: What the provider answered, when it did.

A call with the targets it tried, in order. The fields of a

is true, and the tokens are those of the cached answer, so usage
reports count them; no provider was called.

The tokens and cost are an estimate: a stream that ended without the
provider's report (the caller went away, or an error came after
content was sent) is charged the input of the call and the streamed
characters / 4, and `priced` stays true when the model has a price.

provider.description: The provider that answered; null when nothing answered (the model is then null too).

requested.description: The model or route name the caller asked for.

window_minutes.description: Failures older than this no longer count.

The CSRF token of the session. `null` for a caller with an access

output_price_micros.description: What a million output tokens cost, in millionths of a dollar.

PlaygroundChatAnswer.description: The answer of `/v1/chat/completions`, in the OpenAI shape.

PlaygroundChatRequest.description:
A chat request, as `/v1/chat/completions` takes it. The body is read by
the same parser as that call's, so any field it accepts is accepted here.

model.description: A model as `provider/name`, or a route name.

PlaygroundErrorBody.description:
An error of this call: the CSRF and sign-in errors have the `/api` shape
(`code`, `message`); the pipeline's own have the OpenAI shape (`message`,
`type`, and sometimes `code`).

code.description: `null` in the OpenAI shape, except for a spent budget.

type.description: Only in the OpenAI shape, such as `permission_error`.

weight.description: Share of the traffic among the primaries, 1 to 1000.

model_id.description: Zero for a caller who is not an admin.

weight.description: Zero for a caller who is not an admin.

ProviderView.description:
A provider as `/api` shows it: whether it has a credential, never the
credential.

invite_link.description:
The link that lets the user set a password. It is shown once, in
this answer, and cannot be read again.

Role.description: A user's role in the organization.

fallbacks.description: `provider/model`, in the order they are tried.

cache_enabled.description:
Keep the answers of calls to this route and give them again to the
same call, without a provider. Streams and calls with a temperature
above 0.5 are never kept. Not sent: off.

cache_scope.description:
Whom a kept answer is given to: `team` (the team of the key; a key
with no team uses `user`, then `key`), `key` or `user`. Never across
teams. Not sent: `team`.

cache_ttl_s.description: How long an answer is kept, 1 to 86 400 seconds. Not sent: 300.

everyone.description:
Every user may use the route. It cannot be combined with teams.
Without it and without teams only admins may use the route.

fallbacks.description: Model ids, tried in this order when the primaries fail.

name.description:
1 to 64 characters of `a-z`, `0-9`, `.`, `_`, `-`, starting with a
letter or digit. No `/`, so a route never reads as `provider/model`.

primaries.description: At least one. A model appears at most once in the route.

team_ids.description: Teams that may use the route.

total_timeout_ms.description: 1 000 to 3 600 000, not below the first token timeout.

RouteView.description:
A route. For a caller who is not an admin, `model_id`, `weight`, every
setting, `everyone` and `team_ids` are hidden: they read as 0, false or
empty whatever they are. Only the names and flags of the targets are real.

broken.description: No target of the route is enabled, so it cannot serve a request.

cache_enabled.description: The route keeps answers. Hidden (false) for a non-admin.

cache_ttl_s.description: Seconds an answer is kept. Hidden (0) for a non-admin.

everyone.description: Every user may use the route. Hidden (false) for a non-admin.

amount_micros.description: The amount in millionths of a dollar: 1 to 1 000 000 000 000 000.

scope_id.description: The id of the team, user or key. Not sent for the gateway.
The id of the team, user or key. Not sent for the gateway.

session_hours.description: 1 to 720. Not in the file: not changed.

log_retention_days.description: How many days request logs are kept before they are deleted.

session_hours.description:
How many hours a session lives, from sign-in. Sessions that exist
keep the lifetime they were made with.

trusted_proxies.description:
The networks (CIDR) whose forwarding headers are believed, as the
gateway was started. Read only: it is a flag of `ultrafast serve`.

added.description: The names that were new, now in the catalog and disabled.

existing.description: How many names the provider listed that were already there.

TargetHealth.description: The health of one target, as `GET /api/routing/health` shows it.

failures.description: Retryable failures. A request the provider rejected is not one.

last_failure_at.description: When the last of those happened (UTC, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`).

last_status.description:
What the provider answered to the last of them; none when it did not
answer.

TargetState.description: What the breaker of a target allows now.

TeamRole.description: A user's role inside one team.

TeamSummary.description: A team with the number of its members.

TokenStatus.description: Whether a token can still be used, as of the moment of the answer.

TokenView.description: A token as `/api` shows it. It has no field for the token or its hash.

status.description: Worked out when the answer is made.

enabled.description: Left out, the model stays as it is.

input_price_micros.description:
Millionths of a dollar per million input tokens, 0 or more. Left
out, the price stays; `null` makes it unknown.

api_key.description: Absent leaves the key, `null` removes it, a string replaces it.

session_hours.description: 1 to 720. Applies to sessions made from now on.

from.description: First day of the range, `YYYY-MM-DD`, UTC.

to.description: Last day of the range, `YYYY-MM-DD`, UTC.

UsageRow.description: Sums over one group of calls.

cancelled.description:
Calls the caller abandoned before they were answered (status 499): not
errors of the gateway or of a provider.

errors.description: Calls answered with a status of 400 or more, except 499.

group.description:
The day (`YYYY-MM-DD`), the model name, or the id of the key, user or
team. Empty for calls that have no key, user or team. `total` in the
total row.

input_tokens.description:
Includes the tokens of cached answers (`cached` rows of the logs),
which cost nothing.

label.description:
What to show: the day, the model name, the key or team name, the
user's email, `(none)` for calls without a key, user or team,
`(deleted)` when that object is gone, `Total` in the total row.

unpriced_requests.description:
Calls that reported token usage but could not be priced, so their
cost is missing from `cost_micros`.

UserStatus.description: The state of a user account.

UserTeamView.description: A team of a user, with their role in it.

UserView.description: A user as `/api` shows it. It has no field for the password hash.

teams.description: The user's teams, ordered by name.

token.description: An access token, which starts with `uf-at-`.
